subject: Pause-the-clock request: keep pilot active while PO is in flight
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Emma Collins <emma@clearpathhealth.com>, John Park <john.park@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@clearpathhealth.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pause-the-clock request: keep pilot active while PO is in flight

Hi Emma / John,

Quick note following up from our call this morning — thanks again for the time. I understand procurement is working the PO and that the contract will route this week, but the demo environment is on a tight timer and the ClearPath team’s evaluation work would be interrupted if we let the account lapse.

To avoid losing momentum, would ClearPath be comfortable with a short pause-the-clock while your PO clears? From our side we can:
- Provide a 7-day token voucher to keep the sandbox live,
- Temporarily extend the pilot expiration date by 7 days, and
- Share a one-page mutual action plan so your procurement/legal folks have a single reference for signoff items.

If you can confirm that the PO will be issued within 5 business days, we’ll provision the tokens and extend the pilot immediately. If procurement needs a longer window, tell me how many days and we’ll escalate internally.

I’ve attached a draft mutual action plan that shows deliverables and next steps.

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_ClearPath.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if that helps move procurement.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Thanks, Irene — appreciate the proactive approach.

We’re in the final stages with procurement; a PO is expected to be approved but may not clear payment ops for 3–5 business days. Legal has one minor redline on the DPA which procurement is routing alongside the PO.

A 7-day extension and token grant would be perfect to keep the team running through user acceptance testing. Also please confirm the code and extension details in writing so I can share with my procurement lead.

I’ll loop procurement directly if you need a contact for the PO status.

Karthik / Ben — forwarding Emma’s reply. Summary: procurement expects PO in 3–5 business days, legal has a small DPA redline, and they’ve asked for the extension in writing. Proposed plan below; please chime with objections.

Proposed plan (low risk, keeps momentum):
1) Issue a 7-day sandbox-only voucher code tied to account CLEARPATH-4821.
2) Extend pilot expiration for the tenant by 7 days (dry run environment only).
3) Attach the Mutual_Action_Plan_ClearPath.xlsx as the reference for next steps and include the HubSpot deal link in our note to procurement.
4) Ask for a PO ack (screenshot/PDF) once issued to record in the deal.

Risk notes: token voucher must be sandbox-limited to avoid accidental production usage. If procurement signals >7 days, we should consider a short exec exception and alert finance.

If you approve, I’ll send the formal confirmation to Emma and include voucher details + instructions for procurement.

Irene
